text:
elaine_cs: FYI - renewal-triage for NovaRetail. Usage down ~72% last 7d after Mar 10, seats frozen by procurement. They mentioned a procurement lead switch to 'S. Kim' and LuminaAI just pitched them 6mo credits. Also saw 2x 503s from our inference gateway yesterday. Need quick triage + a preservation play.

mike_csm: ack. Can you post the usage trend link and any error snippets? I'll ping sales/procurement owner.

elaine_cs: trend: https://redwood.internal/graphs/nova-retail/usage-7d (internal). Error snippet below from their logs:
```
POST /v1/infer 503
{"error":"upstream timeout: kv-cache-miss -> sync fallback"}
```
Procurement said they want vendor credits or an extended free POC.

priya_se: looking. Short summary from infra: repeated KV cache miss for long-prefix prompts, batch scheduler fell back to sync path which overloaded CPU on the edge pool -> transient 503s. Repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"prompt":"<large-prompt>"}' --max-time 8
# returns 503 with upstream timeout
```
I have a safe config patch (lower fallback threshold, warm KV on startup) in PR #8123. Can stage to their Dedicated pool for a quick smoke.

jordan_sales: procurement asked for a 50k token credit or 6 months free from vendor. Sales view: instead of outright credits we can offer a 2-week Dedicated trial (isolated pool) + 10% pilot discount. Need pricing sign-off from Amanda. @mike_csm can you escalate?

mike_csm: will escalate to Amanda + legal for trial T&Cs. Also want a short-run remediation email to customer to buy time. Elaine, want me to draft?

elaine_cs: yes please - short note: acknowledge, we saw transient errors, patching, offering dedicated trial while we stabilize, ask for top-20 prompts to warm cache. Ask them for decision on credits vs trial this week. :eyes:

priya_se: can enable prefix-caching and pre-warm KV if they share their common prompts. That will reduce cold-path misses massively. If sales ok with staging, I can push config to their trial pool tonight.

jordan_sales: I'll offer the trial as tactically equivalent to credits (they get guaranteed performance). Also will push LuminaAI counter-argument: long tail cost of warmups and enterprise SLA.

incidents-bot: Created INC-4821: NovaRetail gateway 503 surge. Priority: P2. Assigned: priya_se.

elaine_cs: action items so far: 1) Mike escalate pricing/legal for trial (Amanda) 2) Priya stage patch + enable prefix-caching on trial pool 3) Jordan position trial vs credits in procurement convo 4) Elaine to schedule 30-min sync with their ML lead to request top prompts and confirm acceptance criteria. I'll set a meeting for tomorrow 11am PT.

mike_csm: drafted escalations sent to Amanda & Legal. Added a placeholder in CRM for credit-vs-trial decision.

priya_se: PR submitted, CI passed. Ready to stage when you confirm Dedicated pool ID.

elaine_cs: pool ID requested from sales. Thanks everyone - let's keep this tight, next update in this thread after the staging test. :thumbsup:
